profile:
COMPANY NAME: Zoom
INDUSTRY: Communication & Collaboration / Enterprise Software
PRODUCT OR SERVICE: An AI-first work platform offering a suite of tools including video conferencing, chat, phone, mail, calendar, and customer experience solutions.
TARGET CUSTOMERS: Small and midsize businesses, enterprises, developers, and specific industries such as education, healthcare, financial services, and government.
PRICING MODEL: Freemium / Enterprise
KEY FEATURES: 
- AI-first collaboration tools (Meetings, Chat, Phone, Mail & Calendar)
- Customer Experience (CX) suite including Contact Center and Workforce Management
- Developer tools including Video SDK, Co-Browse, and APIs
- AI Productivity Suite for turning discussions into deliverables
- Extensive marketplace with thousands of integrations and apps
UNIQUE SELLING POINTS: 
- "AI that turns conversations into action"
- Unified platform connecting communication, productivity, and employee engagement
- Comprehensive business services for sales, marketing, and HR
- Robust developer ecosystem for embedding and integrating Zoom technology
TONE & POSITIONING: Enterprise / Professional / Developer-focused
